title: BodySteal
description: BodySteal is a custom plugin where players steal body parts from enemies when killing them, gaining special effects and abilities in a minecraft server.
body:
BodySteal is a unique and immersive PvP plugin designed to turn ordinary survival combat into a brutal progression-based experience. When players kill others, there is a chance to obtain body parts and gain powerful abilities, effects, and combat advantages.

The plugin features a custom body-part system including Arms, Legs, and Chest Parts, each granting different buffs that improve movement, survivability, and PvP strength. Every fight becomes meaningful, encouraging players to become stronger through combat while protecting their own progress.

BodySteal also includes custom effects, progression mechanics, and intense PvP-focused gameplay that creates a competitive hardcore survival environment where every kill matters.

Features:
• Chance-based body part drops on player kills
• Unique effects and abilities for different body parts
• Progression-based PvP gameplay
• Custom combat mechanics
• Hardcore survival and SMP compatibility
• PvP-enhancing systems and player progression
• Lightweight and optimized for multiplayer servers

Perfect for:
• Lifesteal-style SMP servers
• Hardcore survival servers
• PvP-focused communities
• Competitive multiplayer gameplay

BodySteal adds tension, progression, and strategy to every encounter, making survival combat far more intense and rewarding.
